purpose: Option A pilot - data-availability research only. No page-template and no data-file changes were made.
method: 20 courses sampled across the 6 phase-1 universities. Each course's official university page was fetched live (all 20 returned HTTP 200) and read manually for three categories: named module/curriculum lists, course-specific entry requirements beyond IELTS, and university-published career outcomes. Nothing was estimated or inferred; every grade below reflects text actually present on the university page.

modules.FULL+DESC: named modules with credits AND descriptions
modules.PARTIAL: year-level prose only, no named list
modules.NONE: not on the page; outbound catalogue link only

entryRequirements.FULL+INDIA: course-specific grades/prerequisites on page PLUS an Indian-qualification block
entryRequirements.FULL+PORTFOLIO: course-specific grades/prerequisites including a portfolio requirement
entryRequirements.FULL: course-specific grades/prerequisites on the page itself
entryRequirements.EXTRA-FETCH: not in the course page HTML; needs a sub-page fetch or AJAX form emulation

careerOutcomes.NAMED: university names actual employers (sometimes with roles)
careerOutcomes.ROLES: university publishes a role/job-title list but no employers
careerOutcomes.GENERIC: prose only - nothing course-specific to harvest
